# ARLing

> ARLing s. r. o. builds business software: browser tools and small hosted services for e-invoices (EN 16931, Peppol, XRechnung), SEPA and bank files, print approvals, supplier document renewals and website technology tracking. Alongside that it publishes developer diagnostics, free daily logic games and a small range of digital books for e-ink tablets. Product pages and checkout are the source for current prices and terms.

## What it does

ARLing is a one-person software company in Bratislava, Slovakia. Business software comes first: e-invoice checking and creation, SEPA payment files, bank statement conversion, payment matching, GDPR documents, ARLing Proof for print approvals, ARLing Renewals for supplier documents and Stacklog for website technology history. Invoice validation, previews and CSV conversion run in the browser; paid exports use checkout and access verification. Hosted services (Proof, Renewals, Stacklog) run on ARLing's own server and describe their data handling on their product pages. Publishing (puzzle books, journals, classics for e-ink) is a secondary line.

## Who it is for

People handling invoices, bank files or technical errors can choose a task-specific tool. Print and sign shops can run customer approvals in ARLing Proof. Market and event organisers can collect supplier documents in ARLing Renewals. Developers can check what a website runs on with Stacklog or debug auth, CORS, JWT and redirect problems with the free diagnostics. Readers and puzzle solvers can preview and buy digital books, families can give a Memory Post subscription, and publishers can evaluate licensed puzzles for their newsletters. These are separate offers with their own scope.

## How to use

Start at https://arling.sk/ (SK), https://arling.sk/en/ or https://arling.sk/de/. The homepage lists the business software first and has a full directory of every tool, game and book at https://arling.sk/en/#vsetko. Browse paid books at https://arling.sk/shop/ and open a sample before buying. Free and paid features are identified on each product page; some services use checkout, email delivery or an account. Social profile visitors can use https://arling.sk/links/ (EN), /links/sk/ or /links/de/.

## Tools

- **ARLing Proof: print approvals with a record of who approved what**: https://arling.sk/proof/
  Free, capacity-limited pilot for small print and sign shops. Share a print preview (PNG or JPEG up to 5 MiB) with versioned production details through a private customer link; the customer approves a specific version or requests changes, and the decision is kept with the version it belongs to. JSON and printable record export. Owner interface in English and Slovak, customer review in English, Slovak, Czech and German. No published price during the pilot. Hosted on ARLing's own server. Slovak: https://arling.sk/proof/sk/ , German: https://arling.sk/proof/de/ .
  llms.txt: https://arling.sk/proof/llms.txt

- **Stacklog (SK: Technologie webov): what a website runs on, and when it changed**: https://arling.sk/technologies/
  Check any public domain and get the technologies that can be seen from one HTTPS request to the homepage, each finding with the exact evidence line behind it (response header, cookie name, meta tag, file path, script URL, DNS record or certificate field) and one of four confidence levels. Thirteen hygiene checks per site (HTTPS, HSTS, CSP, robots.txt, sitemap, manifest, real 404, canonical, JSON-LD, viewport, llms.txt, compression, certificate). Free without an account: 20 live checks a day, full evidence, no e-mail wall. Aggregate usage statistics for .sk and .cz are published only after the survey has run; until then those pages are marked as an example and carry noindex. No registrant data, no e-mail addresses, no contact lists, ever. Slovak mirror: https://arling.sk/technologie/ ; method and weaknesses: https://arling.sk/technologies/methodology/ ; crawler and opt out: https://arling.sk/technologies/crawler/ ; API: https://arling.sk/technologies/api/

- **ARLing Renewals: supplier documents and renewals**: https://arling.sk/renewals/
  Invite-only pilot for market and event organisers. Collect documents through a private supplier link, record human approval, track expiry dates and export records. Independently hosted on ARLing's own server; no AI API is required. The app and supplier portal are in English; information pages are also available at /renewals/sk/ and /renewals/de/. Reminders are in the workspace, not email. No active price or checkout; no legal or insurance assessment.
  llms.txt: https://arling.sk/renewals/llms.txt

- **Redirect Doctor: Expo + Supabase OAuth**: https://arling.sk/expo-supabase-auth-doctor/
  Paste your Expo scheme, runtime, Supabase project URL / Site URL / redirect allow-list, and OAuth provider redirect URIs. Get the expected redirect URL for every Expo runtime (Expo Go, dev build, standalone, web), the exact mismatches with severity, copy-paste fixes, and a checklist. Free, client-side, nothing uploaded.
  llms.txt: https://arling.sk/expo-supabase-auth-doctor/llms.txt
  llms-full.txt: https://arling.sk/expo-supabase-auth-doctor/llms-full.txt
  GitHub: https://github.com/AndryRoby/expo-supabase-auth-doctor

- **Supabase Auth Redirect Doctor: web apps**: https://arling.sk/supabase-redirect-doctor/
  For Next.js, Vite and SvelteKit apps where Supabase OAuth redirects to localhost or fails in production. Enter your Site URL, redirect allow-list, callback route and provider settings and get the exact mismatch and the fix. Free, client-side, nothing uploaded.
  llms.txt: https://arling.sk/supabase-redirect-doctor/llms.txt
  llms-full.txt: https://arling.sk/supabase-redirect-doctor/llms-full.txt
  GitHub: https://github.com/AndryRoby/supabase-redirect-doctor

- **Supabase Auth Deep Link Doctor: Flutter**: https://arling.sk/flutter-supabase-doctor/
  For Flutter apps using supabase_flutter where signInWithOAuth or a magic link doesn't deep-link back into the app on Android or iOS. Paste your Info.plist, AndroidManifest, redirectTo and Supabase config and get the exact mismatches, severity, copy-paste fixes and a checklist. Free, client-side, nothing uploaded.
  llms.txt: https://arling.sk/flutter-supabase-doctor/llms.txt
  llms-full.txt: https://arling.sk/flutter-supabase-doctor/llms-full.txt
  GitHub: https://github.com/AndryRoby/flutter-supabase-doctor
- [GDPR dokumenty pre firmu a e-shop](https://arling.sk/gdpr-dokumenty/): Slovak GDPR document generator that runs in the browser; the privacy policy (Art. 13 GDPR) is free, the bundle of up to ten documents (records of processing activities Art. 30, processor agreement Art. 28, cookie policy per Act 452/2021 Coll. sec. 109(8), consents, employee notice, internal policy, breach procedure Art. 33 and 34, data-subject request procedure Art. 15 to 22, CCTV) is sold as a one-off purchase through Stripe and downloads as DOCX; see the product page and checkout for the current price. Templates, not legal advice; nothing is sent to a server. Czech version with Czech law (Act 110/2019 Coll., Act 127/2005 Coll. sec. 89(3), Labour Code sec. 316): https://arling.sk/gdpr-dokumenty/cs/ ; German version with German law (DSGVO, BDSG sec. 26 and 38, TDDDG sec. 25, AO sec. 147, HGB sec. 257): https://arling.sk/gdpr-dokumenty/de/
- [Vzory zmlúv](https://arling.sk/vzory-zmluv/): five Slovak contract templates filled in and assembled in the browser: residential lease (Civil Code Act 40/1964 Coll. sec. 685 et seq., or short-term lease under Act 98/2014 Coll.), vehicle sale between private individuals (sec. 588 et seq. and Act 8/2009 Coll. sec. 116), power of attorney (sec. 31 et seq.), deed of gift (sec. 628 et seq., cadastre rules of Act 162/1995 Coll. sec. 42 for real estate) and notice to terminate a residential lease (sec. 710 and 711, or Act 98/2014 Coll. sec. 7). Free: full preview and DOCX download for all five templates, no account, no payment. A free magnet for ARLing; the paid tools are the GDPR document pack and the e-invoice check. Templates under Slovak law, not legal advice; nothing typed in is sent to a server.
- [E-faktúra](https://arling.sk/efaktura/): browser tool for electronic invoices under EN 16931 and Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 (UBL 2.1), with XRechnung rules for Germany. Checks an invoice XML and explains every finding in plain language with the rule code, the path to the element and the original English wording of the rule; renders the file as a readable document; and builds an e-invoice from a form for people without accounting software. In Slovakia the e-invoice becomes mandatory for VAT payers in domestic business-to-business supplies on 1 January 2027 (Act 385/2025 Coll. amending the VAT Act 222/2004 Coll., new sec. 76a; source: Financial Administration FAQ 9/DPH/2025/IM). Check and preview are free, downloading the finished XML costs 2.90 EUR for one invoice or 9.90 EUR for 30 days, one-off via Stripe. Everything runs in the visitor's browser, no file is uploaded. Czech version: https://arling.sk/efaktura/cs/ ; German version: https://arling.sk/efaktura/de/ ; English version for use outside Slovakia, Czechia and Germany: https://arling.sk/efaktura/en/ (same engine, EN 16931 is a European standard and Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 is used across the EU and by a growing number of countries outside Europe; the English sample invoice is a cross-border reverse-charge supply with GS1 GLN electronic addresses, schemeID 0088)
- [Zmeny FAQ k e-faktúre](https://arling.sk/efaktura/zmeny-faq/): every 2026 version of the Slovak Financial Directorate FAQ on e-invoicing, 9/DPH/2025/IM (10 versions from 3 March to 15 September 2026, 22 to 59 pages), with the questions added, changed (word-level diff) and removed in each version and a link to the original PDF; checked daily, optional free e-mail alert on a new version (double opt-in, one-click unsubscribe).
- [Kontrola e-shopu](https://arling.sk/kontrola-eshopu/): free check of a Slovak e-shop address against seven legal points (withdrawal function required from 19 June 2026 under § 20a of Act 108/2024, links to the discontinued ODR platform, privacy policy link, third-party services named in the privacy policy, cookie consent tool, company ID and address, terms and complaints); reads the home page and at most three linked pages, without a browser and without AI, every row with its legal source; not legal advice.
- [Puzzle video](https://arling.sk/puzzle-video/): makes a vertical puzzle video for TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels in the browser: the question, the rule, a countdown of 10, 20 or 30 seconds and the answer, from 6000 puzzles with exactly one solution; free with a credit line.
- [Odstúpenie od zmluvy](https://arling.sk/odstupenie/): withdrawal from a contract directly on the page under sec. 20a of Slovak Act 108/2024 (name, contract details, e-mail, confirmation of receipt at once and by e-mail), plus a model letter; EN /odstupenie/en/, DE /odstupenie/de/.

E-invoice rule codes explained: every rule code our e-invoice checker reports has its own static page in four languages, with what the rule checks, the original normative wording quoted with its source, the UBL element and path, a correct UBL 2.1 snippet and a link to the free checker. Indexes: https://arling.sk/efaktura/en/rules/ (English), https://arling.sk/efaktura/de/regeln/ (German), https://arling.sk/efaktura/pravidla/ (Slovak), https://arling.sk/efaktura/cs/pravidla/ (Czech). Codes covered include EN 16931 (BR-*, BR-CO-*, BR-DEC-*, BR-CL-*, VAT category rules), Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 (PEPPOL-EN16931-*, PEPPOL-COMMON-*) and XRechnung (BR-DE-*, BR-DEX-*).
- E-invoice landing pages by search intent: German https://arling.sk/efaktura/de/xrechnung-erstellen/ , https://arling.sk/efaktura/de/xrechnung-validator/ , https://arling.sk/efaktura/de/leitweg-id/ , https://arling.sk/efaktura/de/e-rechnung-freiberufler/ ; English https://arling.sk/efaktura/en/peppol-invoice-generator/ , https://arling.sk/efaktura/en/peppol-validator/ , https://arling.sk/efaktura/en/ubl-invoice-example/ , https://arling.sk/efaktura/en/e-invoice-small-business/ (same tool, each page answers one question and opens the matching tab).
- [Puzzle Studio](https://arling.sk/puzzle-studio/): a puzzle generator that runs entirely in the visitor's browser. Eleven kinds of logic puzzle (Killer Sudoku, Nonograms, Slitherlink, Kakuro, Hashi, Masyu, Nurikabe, Star Battle, Numberlink, Anti-knight Sudoku and a logic grid), four difficulty steps, several board sizes and up to twenty puzzles in one batch. Every puzzle is generated and then handed back to the solver of its own kind, which is asked for up to two solutions; it is shown only when that solver finds exactly one without guessing, and the page prints the measured milliseconds of that check under each puzzle. Downloads: SVG, PNG at 300 dpi with the resolution written into the file, a print sheet with the solutions on the last page, and a ZIP of the whole batch. Two puzzles a day free with a credit line on the picture; Personal 4.90 EUR a month or 39 EUR a year removes the daily limit and makes the credit line optional; the Puzzle Post Bulletin subscription (19 EUR a month) adds a print licence for one publication. No account and no upload: nothing but the licence check after payment leaves the browser.
- [Memory Post](https://arling.sk/memory-post/): a gift subscription that turns one person's memories into a book. Every week one question about their life arrives by e-mail; they answer it on a page that needs no account and no password, and their own words are e-mailed straight back to them. Every month the answers so far are typeset into a hyperlinked PDF with their name on the cover, in the e-ink 157 x 210 mm page plus A4 and US Letter, with a photograph page every ten answers. 260 questions in a fixed order, available in English, Slovak, Czech, German and Polish, and the language is chosen by the buyer. 39 EUR a year or 4.90 EUR a month, with a free sample book and a gift card the buyer prints at home.
- [Puzzle Post](https://arling.sk/puzzle-post/): monthly hyperlinked puzzle book for e-ink tablets, 100 verified logic puzzles in 10 types per issue, free sample, Issue 1 on Etsy, subscription 3.90 EUR a month.
- [Puzzle Post Bulletin](https://arling.sk/puzzle-post/bulletin/): one printable logic puzzle a week by e-mail for parish bulletins, club newsletters, care home activity sheets and school papers; A4 and US Letter PDF with the solution on page two, plus the puzzle block as a 300 dpi PNG 80 mm wide, licensed for one publication with unlimited printed copies; 19 EUR a month, or 39 EUR for three puzzles a week.
- [Morning Quiet](https://arling.sk/morning-quiet/): Catholic lectio divina journal for e-ink tablets (reMarkable, Kindle Scribe, Boox), Book 1 with 31 days of Psalm and Gospel in the Douay-Rheims text, hyperlinked PDF, free 7-day sample, sold on Etsy.
- [Classics for e-ink](https://arling.sk/classics/): public domain novels typeset page by page for e-ink tablets (reMarkable, Kindle Scribe, Boox, Supernote): a cover on page 1, 13 pt serif with 22 lines to a page, a 33 mm notes band at the foot of every page that is a fillable PDF form field, a linked table of contents and a Contents link on every page, as e-ink, A4 and US Letter PDF; 4.90 EUR a title, free sample of the first three chapters.
- [Ben-Hur for e-ink](https://arling.sk/classics/ben-hur/): Ben-Hur: A Tale of the Christ by Lew Wallace (1880), the complete novel in one file of 953 pages, 81 chapters in eight books, 1043 internal links and 935 notes form fields measured in the finished file; e-ink (157 x 210 mm), A4 and US Letter PDF for 4.90 EUR via Stripe, also on Etsy at the same price, free sample of the first three chapters.
- [The Count of Monte Cristo for e-ink](https://arling.sk/classics/monte-cristo/): the anonymous 1846 English translation of Alexandre Dumas, in the five volumes of the source text, 2287 pages in all (479, 523, 504, 414, 367), 117 chapters, 2415 internal links and 2257 notes form fields measured in the finished files; three ZIP archives of five PDFs each (e-ink, A4, US Letter) for 4.90 EUR via Stripe, also on Etsy at the same price, free sample of the first three chapters.
- [Shop](https://arling.sk/shop/): every ARLing title on one page with its price, what is in it and where else to buy it: the ten printable puzzle books, the bundle of ten e-ink puzzle books, Morning Quiet, Ben-Hur, The Count of Monte Cristo, Puzzle Post as a single issue or a subscription, Puzzle Post Bulletin for printed newsletters, and the puzzle planner on Etsy. For one-off digital purchases, follow the product page and checkout for access and download instructions. Subscriptions have their own delivery schedules and email requirements.
- [Puzzle books](https://arling.sk/puzzle-books/): ten PDF puzzle books, 100 puzzles each (Star Battle, Nonograms, Slitherlink, Kakuro, Hashi, Masyu, Nurikabe, Killer Sudoku, Numberlink, Anti-knight Sudoku), four difficulty levels, every puzzle with exactly one solution verified by program; A4 and US Letter, free five puzzle samples, one book 4.90 EUR, all ten 19.90 EUR.
- [3000 e-ink puzzles, ten books](https://arling.sk/puzzle-books/eink-bundle/): the ten e-ink editions of the same puzzle types in one purchase, 300 puzzles a book (100 easy, 100 medium, 100 hard) and 3000 in all, every one with exactly one solution verified by program; ten PDF files of 379 pages on a page of 157 x 210 mm, 12000 internal links and 0 broken links and 0 form fields measured in the finished files, delivered as four ZIP archives of 68.29 MB in all; 12.90 EUR via Stripe, the same ten books are 4.90 EUR each on Etsy, free sample of ten pages. These are different files and different puzzles from the printable A4 books above.

## Privacy

Data handling differs by product. Many invoice and file checks run locally in the browser. Checkout, purchase access, subscriptions, contact forms, email delivery, Memory Post and remote diagnostic lookups require server communication. Do not extend a local-only claim from one tool to the whole site. Consult the individual product and https://arling.sk/privacy/. The site uses self-hosted Umami for usage analytics; Mail Doctor does not load analytics.

## Notes

Short pages that answer one exact error message and link to the tool that checks it: https://arling.sk/notes/

- [Tvorca životopisu](https://arling.sk/zivotopis/): štyri kroky, tri šablóny, výstup po slovensky, česky, nemecky a anglicky, PDF na A4, celé v prehliadači bez účtu.
- [A Shopify AI shopping assistant built from products.json](https://arling.sk/notes/shopify-ai-shopping-assistant-from-products-json/): what Shopify's public products.json feed contains and whether it can be disabled, how a feed-grounded assistant answers and refuses, the theme.liquid setup today, what changes once the Shopify app is approved, and how it compares to Shopify Inbox and Gorgias.
- [An AI shopping assistant for WooCommerce that stores no conversations](https://arling.sk/notes/ai-chatbot-for-woocommerce-without-storing-conversations/): how a feed-grounded assistant answers WooCommerce shopping questions without keeping conversation content, what it cannot do, the 10-minute plugin setup, pricing, and how it compares to Tidio Lyro and Smartsupp Mira.
- [Google Merchant Center feed errors explained](https://arling.sk/notes/google-merchant-center-feed-errors/): the 12 most common Google Merchant Center and Meta catalog disapprovals (id, title, price, GTIN, availability, condition, brand, shipping and tax), the exact spec rule behind each, and the feed fix for Shopify and WooCommerce.
- [Error 400: redirect_uri_mismatch, explained character by character](https://arling.sk/notes/google-redirect-uri-mismatch/): every cause of Google's redirect_uri_mismatch in NextAuth, Supabase and Firebase, with the exact fix for each one.
- [Supabase OAuth redirects to localhost in production](https://arling.sk/notes/supabase-oauth-redirects-to-localhost/): why Site URL and the redirect allow-list fall back to localhost, and the fix for each cause.
- [Expo + Supabase: why the OAuth deep link never comes back to the app](https://arling.sk/notes/expo-supabase-deep-link-not-returning/): what makeRedirectUri() returns per runtime, the Supabase allow-list, and the native-code fix.
- [Supabase Flutter deep link not working](https://arling.sk/notes/supabase-flutter-deep-link-scheme/): six places scheme, host and the underscore bug break a supabase_flutter deep link.
- [Universal links open Safari instead of your Expo app](https://arling.sk/notes/expo-universal-links-open-safari/): how to fix apple-app-site-association, assetlinks.json and app.json.
- [Stripe "No signatures found matching the expected signature"](https://arling.sk/notes/stripe-webhook-signature-verification-failed/): twelve exact causes of Stripe webhook signature verification failing, with raw-body fixes per framework.
- [Banka odmietla súbor pain.001](https://arling.sk/notes/banka-odmietla-pain001/): šesť najčastejších príčin, prečo Tatra banka, SLSP, VÚB alebo ČSOB odmietli XML, a ako ich nájsť.
- [Hromadný príkaz z Excelu do banky](https://arling.sk/notes/hromadny-prikaz-xml-z-excelu/): presné hodnoty polí, BIC, VS/ŠS/KS a limity pre pain.001 XML.
- [Variabilný symbol v SEPA XML: kam presne patrí](https://arling.sk/notes/variabilny-symbol-v-sepa-xml/): VS, ŠS a KS nemajú v pain.001 vlastné polia; kam patria v EndToEndId a v akom poradí.
- [Štruktúrovaná adresa v SEPA platbe: EPC termín odložila, čo platí teraz](https://arling.sk/notes/strukturovana-adresa-sepa-2026/): European Payments Council 9. 9. 2026 odložila koniec neštruktúrovaných adries v SEPA platbách, ktorý mal byť 15. novembra 2026. Nový termín určí v októbri 2026. Čo presne musí byť v pain.001 a ako si súbor overiť zadarmo.
- [Diakritika v SEPA platbe](https://arling.sk/notes/diakritika-v-sepa-platbe/): prečo ČSOB odmietne diakritiku, čo vyžadujú ostatné banky, a presný zoznam povolených znakov.
- [Párovanie platieb z výpisu bez ručnej práce](https://arling.sk/notes/parovanie-platieb-z-vypisu/): ako spárovať platby z výpisu camt.053 s faktúrami podľa VS a sumy, a čo robiť pri čiastočných úhradách, preplatkoch a platbách bez VS.
- [Výpis z účtu do Excelu](https://arling.sk/notes/vypis-z-uctu-do-excelu/): kde v internet bankingu nájsť camt.053, čo presne obsahuje, prečo CSV z banky často nestačí, a ako ho previesť na tabuľku pre Excel aj účtovníctvo.
- [Hromadný príkaz z Excelu](https://arling.sk/notes/hromadny-prikaz-z-excelu/): kedy sa oplatí, čo musí byť v tabuľke, šesť najčastejších dôvodov, prečo banka súbor pain.001 odmietne, a ako ho vyrobiť a skontrolovať.
- [Nezaplatené faktúry a upomienky](https://arling.sk/notes/nezaplatene-faktury-upomienky/): mesačné spárovanie výpisu s faktúrami, tri stupne upomienok so vzormi textov, zákonný úrok z omeškania a paušálna náhrada 40 eur.
- [camt.053 in Excel umwandeln](https://arling.sk/notes/camt053-in-excel-umwandeln/): was im ISO-20022-Format camt.053 steht, warum der CSV-Export der Bank oft nicht reicht, und wie man den Kontoauszug im Browser in eine Tabelle umwandelt, vor dem Import in DATEV, Lexware oder sevDesk.
- [SEPA-Sammelüberweisung aus Excel](https://arling.sk/notes/sepa-sammelueberweisung-aus-excel/): Pflichtfelder je Zahlung, die häufigsten Gründe, warum eine Bank die pain.001-Datei ablehnt, und wie man sie im Browser erzeugt und vor dem Hochladen prüft.
- [camt.053 in MT940 umwandeln](https://arling.sk/notes/camt053-in-mt940-umwandeln-datev/): warum die deutsche Kreditwirtschaft MT940 im November 2025 gestrichen hat, warum DATEV Kanzlei-Rechnungswesen camt.053 trotzdem nicht direkt importiert, was in MT940 und im DATEV-Format Buchungsstapel technisch steckt, und wie man camt.053 im Browser in beide Formate umwandelt.

## Account

- [Account by e-mail](https://arling.sk/ucet/) (also /ucet/en/, /ucet/de/): no password, a 6-digit code by e-mail; shows purchases (GDPR bundle unlock on any device, SEPA file check status, receipts via the Stripe portal), subscriptions and game progress. Nothing else is stored.

- [google-oauth-redirect-doctor](https://arling.sk/google-oauth-redirect-doctor/): Google OAuth redirect_uri_mismatch Doctor: paste the redirect URI from Google's error and your Google Cloud Console list, pick your stack (NextAuth/Auth.js, Supabase, Firebase, Passport, Django allauth, Laravel Socialite, Python google-auth-oauthlib, Expo AuthSession, Flutter, Postman, gcloud) and get the exact mismatch and the string to add.
- [expo-universal-links-doctor](https://arling.sk/expo-universal-links-doctor/): Expo Universal Links & App Links Doctor: paste apple-app-site-association, assetlinks.json and app.json values (associatedDomains, intentFilters, bundle id, team id, package name, SHA256 fingerprints) and get the mismatches and fixes.
- [sepa-pain001-doctor](https://arling.sk/sepa-pain001-doctor/): SEPA pain.001 Doctor for Slovak banks (Tatra banka, SLSP, VÚB, ČSOB): paste a pain.001 XML payment file and get every invalid element (IBAN, BIC, amounts, NbOfTxs/CtrlSum, VS/SS/KS symbols, character set) with a fix, in Slovak. Client-side only.

- [Privacy](https://arling.sk/privacy/): what is collected (visit counts without cookies, optional e-mail list) and what never is.
- [stripe-webhook-doctor](https://arling.sk/stripe-webhook-doctor/): Stripe Webhook Signature Doctor: paste the Stripe error, pick your framework and body handling, and get the exact cause of signature verification failures (parsed body, wrong secret, test vs live, tolerance, proxy) with the raw-body code for your framework.
- [sepa-pain001-generator](https://arling.sk/sepa-pain001-generator/): Excel or CSV list of payments to a SEPA pain.001.001.03 file, checked by the Doctor before download. Slovak, English and German UI (?lang=sk|en|de); static language pages https://arling.sk/sepa-pain001-generator/en/ (English) and https://arling.sk/sepa-pain001-generator/de/ (German, SEPA-Sammelueberweisung aus Excel); country profiles SK (VS/SS/KS symbols, Slovak bank presets) and DE (Verwendungszweck, EndToEndId, Deutsche Kreditwirtschaft rulebook). Client-side only.
- [camt053-to-excel](https://arling.sk/camt053-to-excel/): camt.053 bank statement XML (any bank in SK, DE, AT, CH: Tatra banka, SLSP, VÚB, ČSOB, Sparkasse, Volksbank, UBS) to CSV or Excel for accountants, with references, counterparty and a balance check, CSV presets for DATEV, Lexware, sevDesk. Slovak, English and German UI (?lang=sk|en|de); static language pages https://arling.sk/camt053-to-excel/en/ (English) and https://arling.sk/camt053-to-excel/de/ (German, camt.053 in Excel umwandeln). Client-side only.
- [parovac-platieb](https://arling.sk/parovac-platieb/): Párovač platieb, matches a camt.053 bank statement (or its CSV) against an invoice list from Pohoda, Omega, Money S3, SuperFaktúra, iDoklad or Fakturoid by variable symbol, amount and date; outputs matched, partial, overdue and unmatched lists as CSV. Slovak UI, client-side only.
- [feed-doctor](https://arling.sk/feed-doctor/): Product Feed Doctor, checks Google Shopping, Meta catalog CSV, Shopify products.json, WooCommerce and generic XML/CSV feeds in the browser: 31 rules (missing fields, prices, GTIN checksums, duplicates, links, availability) with fixes and a score, CSV/JSON report, nothing uploaded. English. Sample feed URL for the Fetch button: https://arling.sk/feed-doctor/sample-feed.xml. After an analysis the report links to ARLing Asistent with the same feed URL prefilled.
- [asistent](https://arling.sk/asistent/): ARLing Asistent, an AI shopping assistant widget for e-shops, set up from a product feed (Heureka/Zboží.cz XML as exported by Shoptet or Upgates, Google Shopping, Shopify, WooCommerce, generic XML), grounded answers with product links, no conversation storage, no cookies; free up to 100 conversations a month without a card, then 19 EUR/month up to 1,000 conversations or 39 EUR up to 3,000. Pages: German https://arling.sk/asistent/de/, WooCommerce https://arling.sk/asistent/woocommerce/, Shopify https://arling.sk/asistent/shopify/, Shoptet and Upgates guide (Slovak) https://arling.sk/asistent/shoptet/ and (Czech) https://arling.sk/asistent/shoptet/cs/, Slovak demo shop "Dobrá domácnosť" (fictional, 64 products, Heureka XML feed, nothing can be bought) https://arling.sk/asistent/ukazka/, comparisons (EN, competitor prices dated 2026-09-05) https://arling.sk/asistent/compare/tidio-alternative/, https://arling.sk/asistent/compare/gorgias-alternative/, https://arling.sk/asistent/compare/smartsupp-alternative/. The trial form accepts ?feed=<url> to prefill the feed URL (used by Product Feed Doctor). Beta.
- [bankove-nastroje](https://arling.sk/bankove-nastroje/): Bankové nástroje pre účtovníkov, one Pro licence unlocking SEPA pain.001 Doctor, SEPA pain.001 Generátor, camt.053 do Excelu, and Párovač platieb at once (9 EUR/month or 79 EUR/year); every tool's free tier stays unlimited on its own. Slovak UI, client-side only.
- [cors-doctor](https://arling.sk/cors-doctor/): CORS Doctor: paste the "has been blocked by CORS policy" console error, what your front end sent, and the response headers your server sent back, and get the exact header or value that's wrong, with a copy-paste fix for 11 stacks. Client-side only.
- [jwt-doctor](https://arling.sk/jwt-doctor/): JWT Doctor: paste a JWT and see exactly why it fails (jwt malformed, invalid signature, jwt expired, algorithm confusion, issuer/audience mismatches), with signature verification via WebCrypto for HS/RS/PS/ES algorithms. Client-side only.
- [cookie-samesite-doctor](https://arling.sk/cookie-samesite-doctor/): Cookie Doctor (SameSite, Secure, Domain): paste your Set-Cookie attributes and request context and get the exact attribute or missing fetch credentials option that's blocking the cookie. Client-side only.
- [redirect-loop-doctor](https://arling.sk/redirect-loop-doctor/): Redirect Loop Doctor: paste your redirect chain, Cloudflare SSL mode and server/app HTTPS settings and find the exact pair of rules fighting each other behind ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS. Client-side only.
- [firebase-auth-domain-doctor](https://arling.sk/firebase-auth-domain-doctor/): Firebase Auth Domain Doctor: paste your firebaseConfig authDomain, page origin and Authorized domains list and get the exact cause of auth/unauthorized-domain or a signInWithRedirect that never returns. Client-side only.
- [janii](https://arling.sk/janii/): Janii, a Windows app for wedding photographers that selects the story (about 500 of 5 000 RAW frames) and memories locally, offline, with a reason per frame. Free beta.
- [ČSOB neprijme SEPA súbor: čo skontrolovať ako prvé](https://arling.sk/notes/csob-neprijme-sepa-subor/): Prečo ČSOB odmietne SEPA XML: presný zoznam povolených znakov, pravidlá pre BIC platiteľa aj príjemcu a postup, ako odstrániť diakritiku z exportu.
- [Môžem nahrať bankový súbor do online nástroja? Ako si to overiť](https://arling.sk/notes/mozem-nahrat-bankovy-subor-do-online-nastroja/): Bankový výpis a platobný príkaz obsahujú IBAN, mená protistrán a sumy. Ako spoznáte, či ich webový nástroj posiela na server, a ako si to overíte sami za dve minúty.
- [VÚB označuje BIC príjemcu za povinný, Tatra banka nie: prečo to nie je jedno](https://arling.sk/notes/vub-sepa-bic-prijemcu-povinny/): VÚB označuje BIC príjemcu v SEPA platbe za povinný, Tatra banka ho vie odvodiť z IBAN, ČSOB ho urobila nepovinným. Čo to znamená pre váš export.
- [Čo do SEPA XML naozaj zapisuje váš účtovný program](https://arling.sk/notes/ako-exportuju-slovenske-uctovne-programy-sepa/): Návod ako v Poznámkovom bloku sami overiť, čo SEPA XML z účtovného programu obsahuje: AdrLine, TwnNm, Ctry, EndToEndId, a stav termínu na štruktúrovanú adresu, ktorý EPC odložila.
- [BIC slovenských bánk a ako ho odvodiť z IBAN](https://arling.sk/notes/bic-slovenskych-bank-zoznam/): Štvorčíselný kód banky v slovenskom IBAN a jeho BIC: TATRSKBX, SUBASKBX, CEKOSKBX, GIBASKBX a ďalšie, s odkazom na oficiálny zoznam NBS.
- [NbOfTxs a CtrlSum nesedia: prečo banka odmietne dávku](https://arling.sk/notes/nbOfTxs-ctrlsum-nesedia/): Prečo banka odmietne hromadný SEPA príkaz kvôli GrpHdr/NbOfTxs a CtrlSum, ako si počet transakcií a súčet overiť v Poznámkovom bloku aj v Exceli.
- [pain.001.001.09: čo sa mení oproti verzii .03 a odkedy](https://arling.sk/notes/pain-001-001-09-co-sa-meni/): BICFI namiesto BIC, PostalAddress24, ReqdExctnDt v Dt alebo DtTm. Presné rozdiely oproti pain.001.001.03 a čo je isté a čo nie o termíne na štruktúrovanú adresu, ktorý EPC odložila.
- [pain.001.001.09 versus .03: what actually changes](https://arling.sk/notes/pain-001-001-09-what-changes/): pain.001.001.09 differs from .03 in namespace, BICFI, and a wrapped execution date. The SEPA structured-address rule, originally dated 15 Nov 2026 and now postponed by the EPC, is about the address, not the version.
- [Štruktúrovaná adresa v SEPA: ktoré polia, aké limity, aké kódy krajín](https://arling.sk/notes/sepa-adresa-ake-polia-a-limity/): Polia StrtNm, BldgNb, PstCd, TwnNm a Ctry v SEPA adrese, ich maximálne dĺžky, kód krajiny podľa ISO 3166-1 a tri príklady adresy, ktoré banka prijme.
- [SEPA structured address: the EPC has postponed the deadline](https://arling.sk/notes/sepa-structured-address-2026-deadline/): The European Payments Council has postponed the 15 November 2026 deadline for the structured SEPA address and will set a new date in October 2026. The direction has not changed: a town (TwnNm) and country code (Ctry) in their own fields, and some banks already apply their own, stricter rules.
- [Tatra banka a import hromadného príkazu: čo kontroluje](https://arling.sk/notes/tatra-banka-import-hromadneho-prikazu/): Presný zoznam toho, čo Tatra banka overuje pri importe pain.001: menný priestor, BIC, dátum splatnosti, limit 500 transakcií, modulo 11.
- [Kam se v SEPA XML píše variabilní symbol](https://arling.sk/notes/variabilni-symbol-v-sepa-xml/): Formát pain.001 nemá pole pro variabilní, specifický ani konstantní symbol. Kam se zapisují, v jakém pořadí a jaké mají limity na počet číslic.
- [Banka odmítla hromadný příkaz pain.001: co zkontrolovat](https://arling.sk/notes/banka-odmitla-pain001/): Osm nejčastějších důvodů, proč banka odmítne SEPA XML pain.001, a jak si každý z nich ověřit sami v textovém editoru bez programování.
- [Jak dostat výpis camt.053 do Excelu](https://arling.sk/notes/camt053-do-excelu/): camt.053 je XML výpis z banky, Excel z něj bez úprav udělá text plný značek. Tři bezpečné cesty k tabulce a jak je výpis uvnitř uspořádaný podle ISO 20022.
- [pain.001.001.09 gegenüber .03: was sich konkret ändert](https://arling.sk/notes/pain-001-001-09-was-aendert-sich/): BICFI statt BIC, PostalAddress24, ReqdExctnDt anders verpackt: die echten Unterschiede zu pain.001.001.03. Und warum der EPC den Adress-Termin vom 15.11.2026 verschoben hat.
- [pain.001: welche Felder Pflicht sind und welche Grenzen gelten](https://arling.sk/notes/pain-001-pflichtfelder/): Referenztabelle zu pain.001.001.03: Pflichtfelder, Zeichengrenzen für MsgId, Nm, EndToEndId, InstdAmt sowie feste Werte nach ISO 20022 und SEPA-Regelwerk.
- [The SEPA character set: which characters are safe in a payment](https://arling.sk/notes/sepa-character-set-and-diacritics/): SEPA payment files accept a narrow character set. Accented letters sit outside it: the safe list, what banks do with it, and how to transliterate.
- [Strukturierte Adresse in SEPA: EPC hat den Termin verschoben, was jetzt gilt](https://arling.sk/notes/sepa-strukturierte-adresse-2026/): Der European Payments Council hat das Ende der unstrukturierten SEPA-Adresse verschoben, das für den 15. November 2026 vorgesehen war. Den neuen Termin legt er im Oktober 2026 fest, die Richtung bleibt: Ort und Ländercode in eigenen Feldern.
- [Umlaute und ß in SEPA-Zahlungen: was erlaubt ist](https://arling.sk/notes/sepa-zeichensatz-umlaute/): Der SEPA-Zeichensatz kennt weder Umlaute noch ß. Was das für Ihre Datei bedeutet, wie Banken damit umgehen und wie Sie es beim Export sicher vermeiden.
- [Strukturovaná adresa v SEPA: EPC termín odložila, co teď](https://arling.sk/notes/strukturovana-adresa-sepa-2026-cesko/): EPC 9. 9. 2026 odložila konec nestrukturovaných adres, který měl nastat 15. 11. 2026, nový termín stanoví v říjnu 2026. Co platí dnes a proč se strukturovaná adresa vyplatí i tak.
- [Bank lehnt die SEPA-Datei ab: was zuerst zu prüfen ist](https://arling.sk/notes/sepa-datei-abgelehnt-was-pruefen/): NbOfTxs, CtrlSum, ReqdExctnDt, PmtMtd, ChrgBr, IBAN, Namensraum, Zeichensatz: acht Gründe für eine abgelehnte pain.001-Datei, im Editor selbst prüfbar.
- [SEPA-Datei auf strukturierte Adresse prüfen lassen: EPC-Termin verschoben](https://arling.sk/notes/sepa-datei-pruefen-lassen-vor-15-november/): Der European Payments Council hat den Termin für die strukturierte Adresse in SEPA verschoben, einen neuen legt er im Oktober 2026 fest. Die Prüfung zeigt trotzdem, wo die Adresse noch Freitext ist, damit die Datei auf den neuen Termin vorbereitet ist und bei Banken mit eigenen, strengeren Regeln seltener abgelehnt wird.

## Games
- [Hedgehogs](https://arling.sk/games/hedgehogs/): daily logic puzzle, two hedgehogs in every row, column and flowerbed, no two may touch; generated with exactly one solution, runs in the browser. Difficulty follows the week: Monday and Tuesday easy (8x8), Wednesday and Thursday medium (9x9), Friday and Saturday hard (10x10), Sunday challenge. Hints explain the next logical step; Check reports mistakes first as a count, then shows them.
- [Hedgehogs guide](https://arling.sk/games/hedgehogs/guide/): rules with animations, the four opening techniques, controls, the weekly plan.
- [Hedgehogs practice sets](https://arling.sk/games/hedgehogs/practice/): 24 undated gardens, three sets of eight per level.
- [Hedgehogs archive](https://arling.sk/games/hedgehogs/archive/): every daily garden since 10 September 2025 at /games/hedgehogs/YYYY-MM-DD/, free; solving history stays in the browser.
- [Magpies](https://arling.sk/games/magpies/): daily picture logic puzzle (nonogram), fill the grid following the numbers by every row and column to reveal the picture; generated with exactly one solution, runs in the browser. Difficulty follows the week: Monday and Tuesday easy (8x8), Wednesday and Thursday medium (10x10), Friday and Saturday hard (12x12), Sunday challenge (15x15). Hints explain the next logical step; Check reports mistakes first as a count, then shows them.

- [Magpies practice sets](https://arling.sk/games/magpies/practice/): 24 undated pictures, three sets of eight per level.

- [Otters](https://arling.sk/games/otters/): daily loop logic puzzle, draw the otters' river as one closed loop along the grid lines, a number in a patch says how many of its sides the river runs along; generated with exactly one solution, runs in the browser. Difficulty follows the week: Monday and Tuesday easy (7x7), Wednesday and Thursday medium (9x9), Friday and Saturday hard (11x11), Sunday challenge (13x13). Difficulty follows the week: Monday and Tuesday easy (6x6), Wednesday and Thursday medium (9x9), Friday and Saturday hard, Sunday challenge. Hints explain the next logical step; Check reports mistakes first as a count, then shows them.

- [Hares](https://arling.sk/games/hares/): daily sudoku variant with a chess knight rule, fill a 9x9 grid (6x6 on Monday and Tuesday) so that every row, column and block has each number once and two cells a knight's move apart never hold the same number; from Friday to Sunday an anti-king rule is added (no equal numbers in touching cells, corners included); generated with exactly one solution and solvable without guessing, runs in the browser. Difficulty follows the week: Monday and Tuesday easy (6x6), Wednesday and Thursday medium (9x9), Friday and Saturday hard (knight and king), Sunday challenge. Hints explain the next logical step; Check reports mistakes first as a count, then shows them.

- [Dormice](https://arling.sk/games/dormice/): daily logic grid puzzle (deduction from numbered clues), match every dormouse to a store, a tree and a week; generated with exactly one solution and solvable without guessing (the hardest days ask you to test one assumption), runs in the browser. Difficulty follows the week: Monday and Tuesday easy (3 dormice, 5 categories), Wednesday and Thursday medium (4x4), Friday and Saturday hard, Sunday challenge. Auto cross fills implied crosses; hints explain the next step; Check reports mistakes first as a count, then shows them.
